instruction: Change the font size to 16pt for all text in the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font size to 16pt for all text in the document. Evaluator verifies that all runs in all paragraphs have font size of 16pt.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: all text in document must be 16pt
Metric logic correctly iterates through all paragraphs and all runs to check font size
Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save document before fetching, ensuring fresh state
Expected value (font_size: 16) correctly matches instruction requirement
Proper edge case handling: returns 0.0 for missing files, errors, and None font sizes (default sizes)
Correct use of python-docx library to read .docx format and convert EMU to points
Complete coverage: checks ALL text runs and fails if ANY run doesn't match 16pt
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: metric only checks paragraph text runs, not text in tables, headers, footers, or text boxes - but this is likely sufficient for most simple documents and the instruction doesn't specify these edge cases
